text_en: The Lord is king, he is robed in majesty; the Lord is robed, he is girded with strength. He has established the world; it shall never be moved;
text_cn: 上主为王，以尊威作衣冠， 上主身着德能，腰束大权。 他奠定了大地尘寰， 大地尘寰不再摇撼；

text_en: your throne is established from of old; you are from everlasting.
text_cn: 你的宝座由太初即已建立， 你的存在，从亘古即已开始。

text_en: The floods have lifted up, O Lord , the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their roaring.
text_cn: 上主，江河已经扬波，江河已经澎湃怒号， 江河已经似雷狂啸。

text_en: More majestic than the thunders of mighty waters, more majestic than the waves of the sea, majestic on high is the Lord !
text_cn: 高天的上主，具有大能， 压倒滔滔洪水的巨声， 冲散汪洋大海的波峰。

text_en: Your decrees are very sure; holiness befits your house, O Lord , forevermore.
text_cn: 上主，你的约言，万分忠实可信， 你的殿宇永远应享神圣。
